projectDescription: A Fortran-based numerical computing project for MHD fitting that processes data using Buneman solver. The application reads from bunema_in.dat, processes the data through the buneto subroutine, and outputs results to bunema_out.dat for comparison with reference data.

contextualHelp.buneto: Subroutine that sets up arrays for Buneman's solver with floating-point exception handling
contextualHelp.mainProgram: Reads input data, calls the buneto subroutine, writes output, and compares results with reference data
contextualHelp.dataFormat: Using Fortran fixed-form with real*8 precision values in scientific notation

codeExamples.fileReading: Uses formatted file I/O with specific format statements: 2020 (5e16.9) and 2022 (5i5)
codeExamples.arrayProcessing: Processes large arrays with numerical data, handling potential floating-point exceptions

codingStandards.formatting: Must use Fortran fixed-form format (columns 1-5 for labels, column 6 for continuation, columns 7-72 for code)
codingStandards.languageVersion: Must adhere to Fortran 77 standards with no modern Fortran extensions
